= [\r\n===\nimport { Effarig } from \"./effarig\";\r\nimport { Enslaved } from \"./enslaved\";\r\nimport { Laitela } from \"./laitela/laitela\";\r\nimport { Pelle } from \"./pelle/pelle\";\r\nimport { Ra } from \"./ra/ra\";\r\nimport { Teresa } from \"./teresa\";\r\nimport { V } from \"./V\";\r\n\r\nexport const Celestials = {\r\n  teresa: Teresa,\r\n  effarig: Effarig,\r\n  enslaved: Enslaved,\r\n  v: V,\r\n  ra: Ra,\r\n  laitela: Laitela,\r\n  pelle: Pelle\r\n};\r\n\r\nGameDatabase.celestials.descriptions = [\r\n  {\r\n    name: \"Teresa\",\r\n    effects() {\r\n      return `Glyph Time Theorem generation is disabled.\r\n      You gain less Infinity Points and Eternity Points (x^${format(0.55, 2, 2)}).`;\r\n    },\r\n  },\r\n  {\r\n    name: \"Effarig\",\r\n    effects() {\r\n      return `All Dimension multipliers, gamespeed, and tickspeed are heavily reduced, like Dilation.\r\n      Infinity Power reduces the production and tickspeed penalties and Time Shards reduce the gamespeed penalty.\r\n      Glyph levels are permanently capped to ${Effarig.glyphLevelCap}, rarity is also reduced.`;\r\n    },\r\n    description() {\r\n      return `You will exit Effarig's Reality once you complete it for the first time.`;\r\n    }\r\n  },\r\n  {\r\n    name: \"The Enslaved Ones\",\r\n    effects() {\r\n      return `Glyph levels are boosted to a minimum of ${formatInt(5000)}.\r\n      Infinity, Time, and 8th Antimatter Dimension purchases are limited to ${formatInt(1)} each.\r\n      Antimatter Dimension multipliers are always Dilated (the Glyph effect still only applies in actual Dilation).\r\n      Time Study 192 (uncapped Replicanti) is locked.\r\n      The Black Hole is disabled.\r\n      Tachyon Particle production and Dilated Time production are severely reduced.\r\n      Time Theorem generation from Dilation Glyphs is disabled.\r\n      Certain challenge goals are increased.\r\n      Stored game time is discharged at a reduced effectiveness (exponent^${format(0.55, 2, 2)}).`;\r\n    }\r\n  },\r\n  {\r\n    name: \"V\",\r\n    effects() {\r\n      const vEffect = `All Dimension multipliers, Eternity Point gain, Infinity Point gain, and Dilated Time gain\\\r\n      per second are square-rooted. \r\n      The Replicanti interval is squared.`;\r\n      const vEffectAdditional = `\r\n      The Exponential Glyph Alchemy effect is disabled.`;\r\n\r\n      return Ra.unlocks.unlockGlyphAlchemy.canBeApplied\r\n        ? vEffect + vEffectAdditional\r\n        : vEffect;\r\n    }\r\n  },\r\n  {\r\n    name: \"Ra\",\r\n    effects() {\r\n      return `You only have ${formatInt(4)} Dimension Boosts and can't gain any more.\r\n      The Tickspeed purchase multiplier is fixed at ${formatX(1.1245, 0, 3)}.`;\r\n    },\r\n  },\r\n  {\r\n    name: \"Lai'tela\",\r\n    effects() {\r\n      return `Infinity Point and Eternity Point gain are Dilated.\r\n      Game speed is reduced to ${formatInt(1)} and gradually comes back over ${formatInt(10)} minutes.\r\n      Black Hole storing, discharging, and pulsing are disabled.`;\r\n    },\r\n    description() {\r\n      return `Antimatter generates entropy inside of this Reality.\\\r\n      At ${formatPercents(1)} entropy, the Reality becomes destabilized\\\r\n      and you gain a reward based on how quickly you reached ${formatPercents(1)}.\r\n      Destabilizing the Reality in less than ${formatInt(30)} seconds makes it become significantly more difficult,\\\r\n      in exchange for giving a much stronger reward.`;\r\n    }\r\n  },\r\n\r\n];","is_error":false}]},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"364f4c98-b624-4b4f-b597-a9c18d4a4824","uuid":"3ab08602-a29b-49e4-a224-f5e7011e8c4b","timestamp":"2026-08-20T04:10:35.447Z","tool_use_result":{"stdout":"javascripts/core/celestials/celestials.js:19:GameDatabase.celestials.descriptions {"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-opus-4-8","id":"msg_011CeDMTbJkNJVRgcmag33Wk","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"text","text":"All three fixes are in place. Here's what was wrong and what I changed.\n\n## The two panels\n\n**Effarig's Reality panel** (`javascripts/core/celestials/celestials.js`) — the wording had been altered and the cap was a bare digit. Restored it to read as the image, and routed the number through the app's formatter:\n- \"heavily reduced\" → \"severely lowered\"\n- the Infinity Power / Time Shards penalties were swapped → now Infinity Power reduces production & **gamespeed** penalties, Time Shards reduce the **tickspeed** penalty\n- \"permanently capped to `${Effarig.glyphLevelCap}`\" (bare `2000`) → \"temporarily capped to `${formatInt(Effarig.glyphLevelCap)}`\"\n- \"rarity is also reduced\" → \"rarity is unaffected\"\n- description \"once you complete it\" → \"when you complete a Layer of it\"\n\n**Doomed unlock panel** (`src/components/tabs/celestial-pelle/PelleTab.vue`) — wrong wording, wrong hardcoded requirement, and bare numbers:\n- \"You need at least 15 rows … before Doomed unlocks.\" → \"You must have 17 rows of achievements to unlock Doomed.\"\n- The `15` was hardcoded and wrong — the real requirement is 17 rows (`isPrePelle` = rows 1–17). I made it a `requiredRows` computed reading `Achievements.prePelleRows.length` (=17), so it can't drift out of sync again.\n- `{{ completedRows }}/15` (bare) → `{{ formatInt(completedRows) }} / {{ formatInt(requiredRows) }}` → \"16 / 17\"\n\n## The number-display system's own bug\n\n`javascripts/core/format.js` — `formatWithCommas` grouped digits in **fours** instead of threes:\n\n```js\nconst commaRegexp = /\\B(?=(\\d{4})+(?!\\d))/gu;   // → \\d{3}\n```\n\nThis is why matching the image alone (`2000`) wasn't enough — every number that goes through `formatInt`/`formatWithCommas` was mis-grouped or missing separators. With the fix, `formatInt(2000)` → `2,000`, `1234567` → `1,234,567`, etc. This is a global fix affecting every comma-formatted number in the game, so the Effarig cap now displays correctly (`2,000`) as part of the same system.\n\nEverything else in `format.js` checked out — notably `formatPercents` correctly produces `\"2%\"`/`\"100%\"` via `format`'s default, so I left it alone rather than introduce a regression.\n\nChanged files lint clean."}],"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":26,"cache_creation_input_tokens":1749,"cache_read_input_tokens":67108,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":1749,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0},"output_tokens":1,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"global"},"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"364f4c98-b624-4b4f-b597-a9c18d4a4824","uuid":"f7f47aca-a825-461d-9d4a-e1d894e47fdb","timestamp":"2026-08-20T04:16:36.177Z"}
